description: Agent capability matrix: what each agent supports and what ai-badger scaffolds for it.

hooks.mechanism: Plugin hooks: SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Notification

skills.mechanism: SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter, discovered from .claude/skills/ or plugin dirs
skills.scaffoldedBy: scaffold.py symlink_hermes_skills() for hermes; direct copy for claude

skills.mechanism: SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter, discovered from ~/.hermes/skills/ and external_dirs

mcpServers.mechanism: ~/.hermes/config.yaml mcp_servers (user-global; no project route), with per-server tools include/exclude globs applied at registration
mcpServers.scaffoldedBy: nothing is scaffolded: hermes/adjustments/adjust_mcp.py prints the mcp_servers snippet for the operator to merge (ADR-0014 decision 6)

hooks.mechanism: .github/hooks/*.json — events: sessionStart, sessionEnd, preToolUse, postToolUse, userPromptSubmitted, agentStop, subagentStop, errorOccurred

skills.mechanism: .github/skills/*/SKILL.md or .claude/skills/*/SKILL.md — YAML frontmatter (name, description) + markdown body

customAgents.mechanism: .github/agents/*.agent.md — YAML frontmatter (name, description, tools, model, mcp-servers, user-invocable)

plugins.mechanism: copilot plugin marketplace/install — delivers skills, hooks, agents, MCP servers

mcpServers.mechanism: CLI: .github/mcp.json (repo-committed) or ~/.copilot/mcp-config.json (user-global), each server carrying a tools allowlist. Coding agent: repository settings UI only
mcpServers.scaffoldedBy: mcp_tools.generate_copilot_mcp_json() writes .github/mcp.json; copilot/adjustments/adjust_mcp.py proposes the coding agent's snippet

feedbackLoop.mechanism: Copilot coding agent can create PRs, but no programmatic feed-badger integration

personas.mechanism: pi core has no persona feature of its own; agent files are read by a subagent extension. ai-badger ships its own (features/pi/subagent/index.ts, installed user-scope at ~/.pi/agent/extensions/ai-badger-subagent/) which registers one delegation tool and reads <project>/.pi/agents/*.md itself through fs — not through pi's trust-gated project resource loader — so the personas load in headless `pi -p` runs with no trust decision saved
personas.scaffoldedBy: pi/adjustments/adjust_agents.py — writes <project>/.pi/agents/*.md and installs the subagent extension user-scope

hooks.mechanism: Extension events the adapter subscribes to: input, tool_call, tool_result, session_start, session_shutdown, agent_settled — see pi's extension API docs for the full event set

skills.mechanism: SKILL.md YAML frontmatter, Agent Skills standard — pi does not read .claude/skills/ directly; adjust_skills.py merges this project's .ai-badger/skills/ path into the settings.json skills array (the one discovery route that is not trust-gated)

customAgents.mechanism: <project>/.pi/agents/*.md and ~/.pi/agent/agents/*.md, `name`/`description` frontmatter plus a body used as the agent's prompt; discovery and dispatch belong to whichever subagent extension is installed, not to pi core
customAgents.scaffoldedBy: pi/adjustments/adjust_agents.py — writes <project>/.pi/agents/*.md and installs the subagent extension user-scope

plugins.mechanism: pi install npm: or pi install git:

mcpServers.mechanism: Via pi-mcp-tools extension (settings.json mcp key); that key has no consumer in pi core
mcpServers.scaffoldedBy: pi/adjustments/adjust_mcp.py — merges into ~/.pi/agent/settings.json's mcp key (install=True) or prints the snippet (--no-install)
